messages:
helen: Quick design note: I'd like to prototype an append-only eviction trace log (separate from lease rows) instead of inlining traces. Reason: avoid inflating hot lease writes and keep store compaction simpler. Thoughts?

mike: How would lookups work? we often need a fast view when debugging a prefix hotloop.

helen: Two-tier query: (1) cheap reason tag on lease (1 byte) + last_evict_epoch (8B) for quick signal, (2) trace-log for detailed timeline. Read flow: redwoodctl or Console asks lease fast path; if it needs context it queries trace-log by prefix+epoch window.

sara: Storage/retention concerns: trace-log could grow fast under churn. propose retention default 72h, per-tenant override, and automatic compaction of traces older than retention. Also scrub any identifiers that could be PII.

helen: Agreed. We'll store only hashed request_ids, and NO payloads. Access to full trace entries (even hashes) gated to ops/admin roles.

tim: What about cross-node causality? if handoff happens quickly, we need to ensure events are ordered and not lost. Append-only logs help since every node writes with a monotonic local sequence + epoch and we can reconcile by epoch+seq.

nate: Can we rely on a global sequence? that'll be a perf bottleneck. Better: each node writes traces with node_id + local_counter and we use epoch/lease_id to correlate. A small reconcile step can sort events client-side for presentation.

helen: Exactly. Trace entry proto (sketch):
```
EvictLogEntry {
  prefix_hash: bytes32
  epoch: int64
  lease_id: string
  node_id: string
  local_seq: int64
  reason: enum
  request_id_hash: bytes16  # optional
  ts: iso8601
  meta: string (optional small freeform)
}
```

mike: Nice. How do we avoid duplicate writes during retries? idempotency key?

helen: Use (node_id, local_seq) as the idempotency key. Writers should be able to CAS a small per-node progress marker to make GC simpler. We'll tolerate occasional duplicates and dedupe during reads by idempotency key.

sara: Who owns the retention & privacy policy? I want legal + security signoff before any retention >0.

helen: Security will review. Default retention 72h and allow tenant to lower to 0. We'll surface a Console toggle for tenants that opt out of detailed traces.

tim: Rollout: implement trace-log writer behind flag, then enable query API and redwoodctl. We can ship writer-only first to collect internal metrics (no UI). Spike owners: helen (api/format), nate (writer impl + local_seq), tim (perf harness), sara (privacy/ACL). Timeline: 2 weeks for writer-only spike, 4 weeks for query/UI + docs.

nate: Perf numbers we should capture: trace_write_p95 latency under 99th percentile load, storage delta per-day at 100K evictions/sec, and query latency for 1-hour time window. We'll run a synthetic churn test.

mike: Also add metrics for traces_unavailable_when_requested and trace_dedupe_count. We should add a Circuit Breaker: if trace-log write latency spikes, fall back to just writing the 1-byte reason tag.

helen: Good call. We'll implement a write-failure budget and a fallback to reason-tag-only path. The system will emit an event when fallback occurs.

sara: For Console integration: show a compact timeline with collapsible entries, link to sample request traces (hashed id) and allow copyable diagnostic bundle. Also document what we do NOT store.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created branch feature/evict-trace-log-proto for spike. CI jobs queued. :gear:

mike: One last thing: compatibility with Dedicated/Private deployments. On-prem customers might not want traces shipped to our central telemetry. Design should support local-only mode where traces never leave the cluster.

helen: We'll add a mode flag (central vs local-only) and ensure the query API respects that. For local-only, Console will query the local control plane.

nate: OK I'm +1. I'll start a spike PR for a lightweight writer library and a small redwoodctl demo that prints trace entries for a given prefix.

helen: Thanks all. I'll send a short ADR describing tradeoffs (inline vs log), privacy, and rollout plan. We'll sync after the spike demo. :white_check_mark:
